title: Beyond IceBERT: Open-Data ModernBERT Encoders for Icelandic from 12M to 1B Parameters
abstract: arXiv:2610.36230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: IceBERT, the reference encoder for Icelandic, found that a cleaned web crawl is enough to train a strong model and that starting from a multilingual model can help on some tasks. We revisit both findings with the ModernBERT architecture. We train Icelandic encoders from 12M to 1B parameters on 9B tokens of open data, and rerun IceBERT's benchmarks and five newer tasks for 30 encoders under one protocol with confidence intervals. Our 1B model trained from scratch, to our knowledge the first monolingual Icelandic encoder of that size, is significantly better than IceBERT on all eleven tasks; warm-started from the English Ettin encoder of the same shape, it has the best score of all encoders on every task we rank. Because our model shapes match the English Ettin encoders and the multilingual mmBERT, we can also test the warm start under controlled conditions, at six model sizes and four token budgets. translated_title: 超越IceBERT：基于开放数据的冰岛语ModernBERT编码器（参数规模从12M到1B）
translated_abstract: IceBERT作为冰岛语的参考编码器，其研究发现经过清洗的网络爬虫数据足以训练出强大的模型，且从多语言模型出发（热启动）在某些任务上有所帮助。我们采用ModernBERT架构重新审视了这两个发现。我们在90亿（9B）token的开放数据上训练了参数量从1200万（12M）到10亿（1B）的冰岛语编码器，并在统一协议（含置信区间）下针对30个编码器重新运行了IceBERT的基准测试及五个更新的任务。我们完全从零训练的1B模型，据我们所知是首个该规模的单语冰岛语编码器，在全部十一个任务上都显著优于IceBERT；而从相同结构的英语Ettin编码器热启动后，它在所有参与排名的任务上都取得了所有编码器中的最佳成绩。由于我们的模型结构与英语Ettin编码器和多语言mmBERT相匹配，我们还能在受控条件下测试热启动效果，涵盖六种模型规模和四种token预算。通过移植我们的词表，war（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究基于90亿token开放数据训练了从12M到1B参数的ModernBERT冰岛语编码器，其1B模型是首个该规模的单语冰岛语编码器，在全部11个任务上显著超越IceBERT，并在受控实验中验证了从英语及多语言模型热启动的迁移效果。
